rollback: Restoring an older build after this release is a binary rollback only; it does not lower the vault format. The older build may refuse a vault this release has resealed. Keep the pre-upgrade backup and the recorded compatibility decision, and restore that backup or run the recovery path before rolling back.

minimumFormatDecision.note: The compatibility promise covers the five fixture-backed public releases v0.1.0 through v0.2.2, all format 10 with setup complete. Formats 2 through 9 stay outside the promise as unproven recovery attempts with their exact labels retained. Raising the minimum supported format requires a new recorded decision in this file, and removing a fixture requires a replacement fixture or a new recovery decision.
